concept: Compute Savings Plan: flexible discount for a steady baseline
tests: Choosing a commitment model for a 24/7 baseline with planned instance family changes and moves between EC2 and Fargate.
expected: Compute Savings Plan — a $/hour commitment that applies to any family, Region, OS, plus Fargate and Lambda. Triggers: "steady 24/7 baseline", "change instance family", "EC2 ↔ Fargate", "maximum savings with flexibility".
why_not: EC2 Instance Savings Plan and Standard RI are tied to family/Region (or type); On-Demand is flexible but undiscounted — the most expensive for 24/7.
